concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 1 – Setup and first end‑to‑end analysis (T005)
concerns.text: Task T005 computes SHA‑256 checksums for artifacts (train.csv, test.csv, cv_metrics.json, performance.json, etc.) that are not produced until later phases. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer dependency; the checksum task should be moved after the artifacts it verifies (or split into phase‑specific checksum tasks).

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – Complete the study and validate its evidence (T014)
concerns.text: Task T014 defines the feature‑matrix schema, which is a foundational artifact needed to validate the feature CSV produced in T003/T015. Placing the schema definition after those tasks violates the ‘foundational tasks first’ principle; the schema task should precede any feature‑engineering or validation steps.
